description: Changes the connector's account's My Gear, in one call. add puts new pieces in; one the account already holds (same brand, name and variant) comes back as already_have and is left as it was. update changes pieces by the ids get_my_gear gives, only the fields sent, null clearing one. A piece that names a catalog_id, as it is added or later, is linked to that catalog row and takes its brand, name, variant, gear type and weight where none were given; null unlinks it. remove puts pieces away by id: they stop being offered on lists, and the lists that still carry them will not bring them back. restore brings put-away pieces back. Each piece answers for itself, in the order sent. What is added or changed here counts as the owner's own word on the piece, so a list saved later cannot overwrite it. Needs a read-and-change access token.
